title: Auth header names come from current primary docs
purpose: Cutoff memory invents OpenAI-only Bearer on Anthropic, or omits anthropic-version.
trigger: Generated client uses the wrong header set for the provider (Authorization vs x-api-key, missing anthropic-version, Gemini key on Vertex, OpenAI key on api.x.ai).
correct: Copy the header set from the provider article in this sphere for the observed_as_of date, then re-check docs if the date is stale.
legacy_evidence_note: Public shapes only. This rule does not describe how to obtain or steal keys.

provenance.claim: Rule preserved from v0.2; classification metadata added conservatively.
